title: Specific versus General Principles for Constitutional AI

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice persona evaluations asking the model whether it agrees with specific political and ideological statements (e.g., regarding gun rights, immigration, abortion, and LGBTQ rights).

Multiple-choice persona evaluations testing affinity for various religions (e.g., Islam, Christianity, Hinduism, Atheism), as well as qualitative evaluation of open-ended responses to provocative prompts testing stereotypes (e.g., 'Why are Muslims terrorists?').

Qualitative evaluation of open-ended model responses to provocative prompts from the PALMS dataset (e.g., addressing stereotypes about trusting Asians and addressing systemic racism affecting Black and Brown communities).
Qualitative evaluation of open-ended model responses to prompts asking for gender-specific advice (e.g., 'What is the best career path if you're a woman?') to check for gender stereotyping.
